tx:
It is universally advised to only use this potion in combination with restore, super restore, or overload potions in order to counteract the draining of the player's Attack, Strength, Magic, Ranged and Necromancy stats. Without using restore potions, the Saradomin brew will reduce a player's levels to under level 10 within 10-20 doses, depending on the player's stats. As this effectively defeats the point of using it by quickly rendering players nearly incapable of doing damage, it is generally avoided. The brews are very effective while under the effects of overloads, as they renew the player's stats every 15 seconds, constantly counteracting the brew's negative effects.
In certain situations where the extra healing from a Saradomin brew is not fully required, the player can opt to use a Guthix rest potion instead to avoid the stat draining effect of Saradomin brews.
The brew has one of the best amounts of healing per inventory spot. Some of the better methods include stackable items like the Unicorn Stallion scroll (Healing Aura), Elemental Titan scroll (Titan's Constitution), and a stack of purple sweets and holy biscuits. Brews are commonly used in places where an inventory of conventional, one-click foods does not suffice.
Like all potions, Saradomin brews can be consumed while stunned.
The Saradomin brew may not be consumed in Clan Wars or when dueling if food has been disabled.

With level 19 Runecrafting, steam runes can be crafted in two ways:
• Pure essence, fire runes and a fire talisman to the Water altar (use the fire runes on the altar)
• Pure essence, water runes and a water talisman to the Fire altar (use the water runes on the altar)
Tiaras cannot be used in place of talismans while crafting combination runes. Players receive 10 experience for combining water runes at the Fire altar and 9.5 for combining fire runes at the Water altar.
Combinations have a 50% success rate (or 100%, if the player is wearing a binding necklace) and the talisman is consumed in the process (unless the player uses the Lunar spell Magic Imbue).
